characters.name: Per
characters.description: Per is described as the youngest of three brothers. He is a young boy, somewhat scruffy in appearance, clearly coming from a humble background. His clothing is simple and shows signs of wear, fitting for his role as the poorer of the three brothers. He is usually seen with a small cat by his side, which he affectionately takes on his journey. His expression is one of determination and innocence, reflecting his kind-hearted nature.

characters.name: Katten
characters.description: This is not an ordinary cat; eventually revealed to be a cursed princess. Initially, the cat appears quite unassuming, with sleek fur and bright, intelligent eyes. It always stays close to Per, often perched at his feet or by his side. Despite its small size, the cat exudes an aura of intelligence and purpose, playing a crucial role in Per's journey by securing gifts for the king.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: The king is a regal figure, dressed in opulent royal attire befitting his status. He wears a richly embroidered cloak and a heavy crown that signifies his royal authority. His demeanor is both curious and gratified when presented with the generous gifts from Per. The king possesses an air of authority and grandeur that commands respect.

characters.name: Den yngste Prinsessen
characters.description: The youngest princess is revealed as a character towards the end, previously cursed to be in the form of a cat. She is the epitome of grace and beauty, dressed in flowing elegant robes. Her long, cascading hair and radiant complexion make her stand out as a regal figure. Her eyes sparkle with kindness and gratitude towards Herreper, whom she marries.

characters.name: Herreper
characters.description: Herreper, formerly known as Per, rises to become a king by the end of the tale. He transforms from a modest boy to a regal figure after gaining wealth and status through his journey. He is depicted as wearing lavish garments that exhibit wealth, with intricate patterns and shimmering fabric. His expression reflects newfound confidence and maturity, signifying his growth and accomplishment.
